comparison.objective: Remove a binder clip before feeding invoices into a shredder; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Pinch a sprung clip off a stack, handle paper, and feed it while avoiding a jam versus precision lock/collar manipulation and guarded carriage cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Invoices shredded with clip removed and no hand/clip entering the slot versus two safe repeatable stops with no overload, bottoming, or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Safety sequencing is shared only generically; the mechanisms and tested outcomes differ.
